# Exploration Decision Workspace

> [!note] Purpose
> Move from regional evidence to ranked, auditable opportunities.

## What the canvas must contain
- Basin and play context
- Lead and prospect inventory
- Evidence maturity and data gaps
- Volumes, risk and decision status

## Grounding inputs
- Regional seismic and interpretation
- Well, log, marker and test evidence
- Play and prospect polygons
- Analogue and PVT assumptions

## Primary user flow
1. Open a prospect
2. Review evidence quality
3. Compare scenarios
4. Route a drill or study decision

## Visualization and interaction
Living portfolio view with evidence maturity, decision gates and ranked data gaps.

## Shared scientific rules
- Preserve truth class: **measured · reported · interpreted · derived · forecast · scenario**
- Use **TVD / TVDSS / MD** explicitly; never mix depth references silently
- Changes create a version or scenario; approved evidence is never overwritten
- Every result links upstream evidence to downstream calculation, decision and approval

## Exit criteria
- Data lineage visible
- Empty, loading, error and partial-data states defined
- Desktop, tablet and mobile behavior specified
- Export target mapped to [[Report]] · [[Document]] · [[Presentation]]

## Industry benchmark to imitate
**SLB Petrel static modeling + GeoX prospect evaluation**

Petrel-style object tree, map-first interpretation, linked sections, surfaces/contacts, deterministic + probabilistic volumetrics; GeoX-style play/prospect chance, risking and portfolio comparison.

## Recommended JavaScript library stack
MapLibre GL JS + deck.gl for large map layers; Three.js for lightweight WebGL 3D; vtk.js when volume/slice rendering is required; D3-delaunay for TIN; Turf.js/JSTS for geometry; ECharts for risking, tornado and uncertainty charts; Apache Arrow/Parquet-WASM for columnar interchange.

## GeaVision renderer lessons harvested
Reuse GVSURF: Int16 quantization with offset/scale, NULL=-32768, gzip + Base64, shared affine grid, row-major arrays, adaptive mesh stride, BufferGeometry, instanced well/marker meshes, batched line segments, capped devicePixelRatio, explicit TVD/TVDSS/MD and contact-as-top-surface intersection.

## Digital Twin Brain standard
- **Knowledge extraction:** Graphify/GraphRAG-style entity, relation, claim and provenance extraction into ASKB Markdown.
- **Knowledge experience:** Obsidian-style local graph, backlinks, wikilinks, timeline and version-aware notes; Sigma.js/Cytoscape.js for WebGL/Canvas scale rather than SVG-only rendering.
- **Data contextualization:** Cognite Data Fusion-like pattern: governed source data + ontology/context graph + assets/events/files/time series + lineage, without copying the vendor UI.
- **Retrieval:** hybrid keyword + vector + graph neighborhood retrieval; every answer returns evidence, truth class, valid time and source revision.
- **Contract:** Knowledge + Data are one Digital Twin Brain. Data remains system-of-record truth; Markdown is the human-readable semantic memory; the graph links both.
